questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum at the rate of 12.5% per annum for 6 years is Rs. 13,500 less than the principal. Find the simple interest.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (principal - 13500)

Rate = 12.5%; time = 6 years

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

Where, P = principal; R = rate; T = time;

**Calculation:**

⇒ S.I = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (P - 13500) = (P × 12.5 × 6)/100

⇒ (P - 13500) = (3/4) × P

⇒ 4P - (13500 × 4) = 3P

⇒ 4P - 3P = 54000

⇒ P = Rs.54000

Simple Interest (S.I) = (P - 13500)

⇒ (54000 - 13500) = Rs.40500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.40500.**

Ram has an average score of 65 runs in 19 innings in cricket matches. Find out how many runs are to be scored by him in the 20th innings to raise the average score to 67.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average score of 19 innings = 65 runs

**Formula used:**

Total run = average run × number of innings

**Calculation:**

Total score in 19th innings = 65 × 19 = 1235 runs

Total run after 20th innings = 67 × 20 = 1340 runs

Total run scored in 20th inning = (1340 - 1235) = 105 runs

**∴ The correct answer is 105 runs. **

questions.question: A metallic cube has each of its side of length 12 cm. It is melted and recast into three small cubes. Out of these cubes, two have their sides as 6 cm and 8 cm, respectively. The length of each side of the third cube is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of a large cube = 12 cm

Size of 1st small cube = 6 cm

Size of 2nd small cube = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of large cube = total volume of small cubes

**Formula used:**

Volume of cube = (side)³

**Calculation:**

Let the side of 3rd cube = x

Volume of large cube = total volume of three cubes

⇒ (12)³ = (6)³ + (8)³ + (x)³

⇒ 1728 = 216 + 512 + x³

⇒ x³ = 1728 - 728

⇒ x = ³√1000 = 10 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10 cm.**

questions.question: A policeman starts chasing a thief when he was already 600 m ahead. If the policeman is running at a speed of 9 km/h and the thief at 8 km/h, then the thief would be caught at a distance of:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between policeman and thief = 600 m

Speed of policeman = 9 km/h

Speed of thief = 8 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 600 = (9 - 8) × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (600 × 18)/5 = 120 × 18

⇒ Time = 2160 sec = (2160/3600) hours

Distance covered by policeman = 9 × (2160/3600)

⇒ (9 × 3)/5 = 5.4 km

**∴ The correct answer is 5.4 km.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought certain number of apples for Rs. 3,600. He sold one-fifth of them at a loss of 10%, one-fourth of the remaining apples at a loss of 5%, and two-third of the rest at a profit of 15%. At what price (in Rs.) should he sell the remaining apples to earn a profit of 27% overall?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) = Rs.3600

Overall profit on apples = 27%

**Concept used:**

If profit P% occurred then

Selling price (S.P) = C.P × (100 + P)%

Where, P = profit%

**Calculation:**

Let the price of one apple = Rs.1

Quantity of apples = 3600

According to the question:

⇒ 3600 × (1/5) × (- 10%) + 2880 × (1/4) × (- 5%) + 2160 × (2/3) × 15% + 720 × (x%) = 3600 × 27%

⇒ - 7200 - 3600 + 21600 + 720x = 3600 × 27

⇒ - 720 - 360 + 2160 + 72x = 360 × 27

⇒ 72 × (- 10 - 5 + 30 + x) = 360 × 27

⇒ 15 + x = 5 × 27

⇒ x = 135 - 15 = 120%

Selling price of rest apple = 720 × (100 + 120)%

⇒ 720 × 220% = Rs.1584

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1584.**

questions.question: If tan α = 6, then sec α equals to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tan α = 6

**Concept used:**

Tan θ = P/B

Sec θ = H/B

Where, P = perpendicular; B = base; H = hypotenuse

**Formula used:**

Pythagorean theorem:

H² = P² + B²

Where, P = perpendicular; B = base; H = hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

Tan α = 6/1 = P/B

Using Pythagorean theorem:

⇒ H2 = P2 + B2

⇒ H² = (6)² + (1)²

⇒ H = √37

Sec α = H/B = √37

**∴ The correct answer is √37. **

questions.question:
In the following figure, there are two circles that touch each other externally. The radius of the first circle with centre P is 25 cm. The radius of the second circle with centre Q is 4 cm. Find the length of their direct common tangent AB.

Radius of large circle = 25 cm

Radius of small circle = 4 cm

Direct common tangent = 2 × √(R × r)

**Calculation:**

Direct common tangent (AB) = 2 × √(R × r)

questions.question: A group of men decided to do a job in 13 days but 9 men left the work after each day. The work, as a result, got completed in 16 days. How many men were initially in the group?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A group of men decided to do a job in 13 days.

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

Sum of n terms = n/2 × [a + l]

Where, n = number of terms;

a = first term; l = last term 

**Calculation:**

Let the number of person in group initially = x

9 men left work after each day.

So it becomes an A.P series.

⇒ x + (x -9) + (x - 18)............ (x - 135) = x × 13

⇒ (16/2) × [x + x - 135] = 13x

⇒ 8 × [2x - 135] = 13x

⇒ 16x - (135 × 8) = 13x

⇒ 16x - 13x = 135 × 8

⇒ x = (135 × 8)/3 = 45 × 8 = 360 persons.

**∴ The correct answer is 360 persons.**

questions.question: Applied to a bill for Rs. 50,000, the difference between a discount of 40% and two successive discounts of 36% and 4%, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.50000

Discount (D)% = 40%

Two successive discounts:

Discount (D₁) = 36% ; Discount (D₂) = 4%

**Formula used:**

Effective discount (Dₛ) = D1 + D2 - (D1 × D2)/100

**Calculation:**

Effective discount (Ds) = D1 + D2 - (D1 × D2)/100

⇒ 36 + 4 - (36 × 4)/100

⇒ 40 - 1.44 = 38.56%

Difference in the bill after discount = 50000 × (40 - 38.56)%

⇒ 50000 × 1.44% = Rs.720

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.720.**

questions.question: Out of the total toffees, (1)/(10) are wasted. 35% of the rest are given to S and (1)/(8) of the total are given to N. If the toffees with N are 10 more than the wasted toffees, then how many toffees were given to S?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total wasted toffees = (1/10) × Total toffees

Toffees got by S = 35% of remaining toffees

Toffees got by N = (1/8) of total toffees

**Calculation:**

Let the total toffees = 200 units

Total wasted toffees = 200 × (1/10) = 20 units

Remaining toffees = (200 - 20) = 180 units

Total toffees S had = 180 × 35% = 63 units

Total toffees N had = (1/8) × 200 = 25 units

According to the question:

⇒ (25 - 20) units = 5 units = 10 toffees

⇒ 1 units = 2 toffees

Total toffees S had = 63 units = 63 × 2 = 126 toffees

**∴ The correct answer is 126 toffees**.

questions.question: A field is 150 m long and 80 wide. How many times (rounded off to 1 decimal place) is its perimeter to the length of its diagonal?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of field = 150 m

Breadth of field = 80 m

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (L + B)

Diagonal of rectangle = √(L² + B²)

Where, L = length; B = breadth

**Calculation:**

Diagonal of rectangle × (X) = perimeter of rectangle

⇒ √{(150)2 + (80)2} × (X) = 2 × (150 + 80)

⇒ √{(22500 + 6400} × (X) = 2 × 230

⇒ √28900 X = 460

⇒ X = 460/170 = 2.7

**∴ The correct answer is 2.7.**

questions.question: When two circles of radii r₁ and r₂ have their centres at a distance d apart, then length of the common transverse tangent is:
questions.solution:

Radius of 1st circle = r₁

Radius of 2nd circle = r₂

Distance between the centre of circle = d

**Calculation:**

Length of common transverse tangent = sqrt{d² - (r₁ + r₂)²}

**∴ The correct option is 4.**

questions.question: If x² - 15x + 1 = 0, what is the value of x⁴ - 223x² + 6?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x2 - 15x + 1 = 0

**Concept used:**

if x + 1/x = P

then x² + 1/x² = P² - 2

**Calculation:**

x2 - 15x + 1 = 0

Divide by x on both sides

⇒ x - 15 + 1/x = 0

⇒ x + 1/x = 15

Now,

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 15² - 2

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 223

Now putting the value in the given expression

⇒ x4 - 223x2 + 6

⇒ x4 - (x2 + 1/x2) × x2 + 6 

⇒ x4 - x⁴ - 1 + 6 

⇒ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**
